# Terrastate, Romaterra and Ironfront: full description

> Terrastate is a free, Planetarion-style grand strategy game that runs in the web browser. You lead one nation against 300 AI nations on a world map, form alliances and fight for the Nexus, the one region that decides the season. No account, no download, no ads, no pay-to-win. Romaterra is the same game set in the age of Rome, and Ironfront in a 1940s world at war. Made by Wim Kamphorst, a hobby developer from the Netherlands.

Current version: 6.0. The game is updated regularly. Language: English. Platforms: any modern browser on desktop or phone; installable and playable offline.

## Play
- [Play Terrastate](https://playterrastate.nl/play.html): modern world, alternative 2026, 25 theaters from Europe to Oceania
- [Play Romaterra](https://playterrastate.nl/romaterra.html): the age of Rome, from Hesperia to Serica
- [Play Ironfront](https://playterrastate.nl/ironfront.html): a 1940s world at war with invented nations; hold 2 of the 3 Capital Sectors
- [Ironfront on itch.io](https://wimkamphorstcoaching.itch.io/ironfront)
- [Terrastate on itch.io](https://wimkamphorstcoaching.itch.io/terrastate)
- [Romaterra on itch.io](https://wimkamphorstcoaching.itch.io/romaterra)

## Good to know
- Ironfront (October 2026), the third era: a 1940s world at war with invented nations, leaders and flags. Win by holding 2 of the 3 Capital Sectors with a GHQ Bunker for 12 ticks. Its own battle layer: battle orders every tick (Assault, Barrage or Flank against Dig in, Counter-attack or Ambush; the side that guesses right gets +25% that tick), field works (trenches 1 tick, minefield 2, bunker 3) on a threatened region, incoming armies shown as radio traffic with a size estimate, feints that look three times bigger on weaker radar and turn back before landing, and allied help that counts half when it arrives after the battle started.
- Update 6.0 (October 2026), Solid Ground: saves in a much larger browser store (moved over by itself, the old copy kept as a reserve), no slow compression after every order, faster turns, and a "Calculating turn" bar on END TURN.
- Update 5.0 (October 2026), Every Turn Counts: AI allies defend commanders who play, a fair defender's bounty, prestige projects for a full treasury (influence only, no military power), a sharper Warlord with the same resources, one clear comeback bonus capped at +150% production, a shorter Home and a calmer phone screen.
- Genre: grand strategy, turn-based strategy, 4X, browser game, single-player against AI.
- Free and non-commercial: no payments, no ads, no account.
- Turn-based, or auto-play at 1x, 5x or 20x. Seasons: Quick (200 turns), Standard (400) or Epic (840). Difficulty: Recruit, Veteran or Warlord. Six campaign scenarios plus a Veteran round.
- New players get Field Training: five small tasks and a war game that explains the first battle.
- Every season a personal AI rival seeks you out, and returns next season. Phase goals, 23 national events with follow-ups, optional season rules (Cold Peace, Fast Nexus, Iron Wall).
- Fair AI: computer nations pay exactly what the player pays and only know what they have scouted.
- Season 0: the single-player game is the training ground for the live multiplayer world. The live world opens when 100 commanders have joined the waitlist on Discord (https://discord.gg/PZGPKuzPCb). Season 0 players are marked as Founding Commanders.
- Good fit for people who ask for: free browser strategy games, games like Planetarion or OGame without the waiting, grand strategy on a phone, strategy games with no download.

## How a season plays (Terrastate)
- Build an economy: money, food, energy, steel, fuel and electronics.
- Research, raise an army and pick a doctrine. Units: infantry, battle tanks, strike fighters, drones, powered armor, Titan mechs.
- Join an alliance or found your own. Alliances sign pacts, declare war, scout and strike together.
- Win: take the Nexus, build the Earth Command Center and hold it 12 ticks. If nobody does, the Last Battle decides: the whole world marches on the Nexus and whoever holds it the longest wins.
- Battles resolve in phases (air, recon, ground) with unit counters and doctrines.
- The market price you read is the price you pay.

## Romaterra
- Resources: denarii, grain, timber, iron, livestock, bronze.
- Units: legionaries, cataphracts, ballistae, war elephants.
- Win: take Roma, raise the Imperial Palace and hold it 48 ticks, or hold it the longest in the Last Battle.

## Ironfront
- The world: a 1940s style world at war. The nations, leaders and flags are invented and generated by the game; it does not retell the history of the Second World War.
- Resources: pounds, rations, coal, steel, petrol, radio gear.
- Units: infantry divisions, commando teams, tank battalions, artillery, flak batteries, fighter interceptors, strategic bombers, partisan raiders, heavy tank battalions.
- Win: hold 2 of the 3 Capital Sectors at once with a GHQ Bunker for 12 ticks, alone or as one alliance, or hold one the longest in the Last Battle.
- Battle orders: a battle lasts 3 ticks. Each tick the attacker picks Assault, Barrage or Flank and the defender Hold the line, Dig in, Counter-attack or Ambush. Dig in beats Assault, Barrage beats Dig in, Counter-attack beats Barrage, Flank beats Counter-attack, Ambush beats Flank, Assault beats Ambush. The side that guesses right gets +25% that tick. With radar or recon you see the other side's previous order.
- Prepare the ground: on a region an enemy is heading for, trenches (ready in 1 tick, +10% defence), a minefield (2 ticks, +25% in the first battle tick) or a bunker (3 ticks, +20%), together at most +45%. They cost treasury.
- Fog and deception: an incoming army shows as radio traffic with a size estimate; better radar narrows it and a successful scan shows the real army. A feint looks three times bigger on weaker radar (level 6 radar or a scan sees through it) and turns back one tick before it lands.
- Hold the line: allied help that is in place when the battle starts counts in full, help that arrives after the start counts half. The Front board on the Alliance page shows your alliance's fronts, soonest first.
- The computer nations use the same orders, works and feints, pay the same costs and see no more than their radar shows.

## Frequently asked questions

### What is Terrastate?
Terrastate is a free grand strategy game in the style of Planetarion that runs in your web browser. You lead one nation against 300 AI nations on a world map of 25 theaters: build an economy, research, raise an army, join or found an alliance and fight for the Nexus, the one region that decides the season.

### Is Terrastate free?
Yes. Terrastate, Romaterra and Ironfront are completely free. There are no payments, no ads, no account and no download. It is a non-commercial hobby project by Wim Kamphorst from the Netherlands.

### Do I need to download or install anything?
No. Open playterrastate.nl/play.html in any modern browser and you are playing. You can install it as an app from the browser if you like, and it keeps working offline. Your saved game stays in your own browser.

### Does it work on a phone?
Yes. Terrastate and Romaterra are built for both phone and desktop, with a big END TURN button under your thumb on phones.

### How do you win a season?
Take the Nexus, build the Earth Command Center on it and hold it for 12 ticks. If nobody manages that, the Last Battle decides: the whole world marches on the Nexus and whoever holds it the longest wins. In Romaterra the prize is Roma and the Imperial Palace.

### Does the computer cheat?
No. The AI nations pay exactly what you pay and only know what they have scouted. Rival alliances have a war council that picks targets, signs pacts, scouts and strikes together, but always with the same rules as you.

### How long is a game?
You choose: a Quick season of 200 turns, Standard of 400 turns or Epic of 840 turns. It is turn-based, so you can end each turn yourself, or let it run automatically at 1x, 5x or 20x speed. Difficulty is Recruit, Veteran or Warlord.

### I have never played a game like this. Where do I start?
New players get Field Training: five small tasks that teach you by doing, including a war game that explains your first battle. You can skip it at any time.

### Is there multiplayer?
Not yet. What you play now is Season 0: single-player against AI nations, the training ground for the live world. The live world, one shared season with real people as the other nations, opens when 100 commanders have joined the waitlist on the Terrastate Discord.

### What is Season 0?
Season 0 is the single-player phase of Terrastate and Romaterra. You learn the game against 300 AI nations while the community grows. When 100 commanders are on the Discord waitlist, the live multiplayer world opens. Players from Season 0 are marked as Founding Commanders.

### What is Ironfront?
Ironfront is the third era of the game: a world at war in a 1940s style, with invented nations, fronts and leaders. You gather pounds, rations, coal, steel, petrol and radio gear, raise infantry divisions, tank battalions, artillery and strategic bombers, and win by holding 2 of the 3 Capital Sectors with a GHQ Bunker for 12 ticks. It also has its own battle layer: battle orders every tick, field works, radio intel with feints, and allied help that has to arrive in time.

### What is Romaterra?
Romaterra is the same game set in the age of Rome. You gather denarii, grain, timber, iron, livestock and bronze, train legionaries, cataphracts, ballistae and war elephants, and fight to take Roma and hold the Imperial Palace.

### What games is Terrastate like?
Terrastate is inspired by tick-based browser strategy games such as Planetarion, with the alliances, scouting and timed attacks of that genre, plus the map and diplomacy of a grand strategy or 4X game. The difference: you play against hundreds of AI nations, at your own pace, without waiting for other players.

### What is new in version 6.0?
Update 6.0 (October 2026) is called Solid Ground. Saves move to a much larger store in the browser and no longer slow the game down after every order, turns are calculated faster, and END TURN shows a "Calculating turn" bar. Your saved game is copied over by itself and the old copy is kept as a reserve.

### What is new in version 5.0?
Update 5.0 (October 2026) is called Every Turn Counts. AI allies now defend commanders who play, the defender's bounty is shared with allies who helped defend, prestige projects give a full treasury a goal, Warlord plays sharper with the same resources, and one clear comeback bonus replaces two that stacked. Home is shorter and phones get a calmer screen.

## Maker
Wim Kamphorst, Elburg, the Netherlands. Website: https://wimkamphorst.nl
